question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are dancers at a square dance. At the start of a song, they each have a partner: Alice is dancing with Karl, Bob is dancing with Umar, Claire is dancing with Quinn, Dave is dancing with Tara, Eve is dancing with Stefan, Fred is dancing with Rosa, and Gertrude is dancing with Priya.
Throughout the song, the dancers often trade partners. First, Bob and Gertrude switch partners. Then, Eve and Claire switch partners. Then, Eve and Dave switch partners. Then, Eve and Fred switch partners. Then, Fred and Gertrude switch partners. Then, Bob and Claire switch partners. Finally, Bob and Eve switch partners. At the end of the dance, Bob is dancing with
Options:
(A) Karl
(B) Umar
(C) Quinn
(D) Tara
(E) Stefan
(F) Rosa
(G) Priya
solution:
Partner order in every row: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve | Fred | Gertrude.
Initial: Karl | Umar | Quinn | Tara | Stefan | Rosa | Priya
1. Bob and Gertrude swap: Karl | Priya | Quinn | Tara | Stefan | Rosa | Umar
2. Eve and Claire swap: Karl | Priya | Stefan | Tara | Quinn | Rosa | Umar
3. Eve and Dave swap: Karl | Priya | Stefan | Quinn | Tara | Rosa | Umar
4. Eve and Fred swap: Karl | Priya | Stefan | Quinn | Rosa | Tara | Umar
5. Fred and Gertrude swap: Karl | Priya | Stefan | Quinn | Rosa | Umar | Tara
6. Bob and Claire swap: Karl | Stefan | Priya | Quinn | Rosa | Umar | Tara
7. Bob and Eve swap: Karl | Rosa | Priya | Quinn | Stefan | Umar | Tara
Bob is dancing with Rosa, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
